title: Norwegian Beef Stew
description: A hearty, keto beef stew with a twist of Norwegian flavors.

ingredients.name: Beef (sirloin or ribeye), cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-fat cut for keto

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef cubes and brown on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the diced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the beef broth, whisking continuously, and bring to a boil.
Return the browned beef to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 hours or until the beef is tender.
Remove from the oven and stir in the Norwegian Beef Seasoning, heavy cream or half-and-half (if using), and chopped thyme.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme and a side of cauliflower mash or a green salad.
